new_records.title: Lattices, graphs, and Conway mutation
new_records.location: Author preprint arXiv1103.0487v1, Section4.1-4.2 printedpp19-23, Corollary4.3, Lemma4.4, Corollary4.5; published Invent.Math.192,717-750 (2013), online11August2012
new_records.audit: Primary graph/drawing/mutation arguments read, including parallel-edge qualification and chosen checkerboard convention; official Springer publication metadata checked. Classical Whitney2isomorphism and plane-drawing results remain explicit imports. Full lattice/Floer proof and published-version comparison not audited.
new_records.scope: Connected reduced alternating diagrams with2isomorphic Tait graphs in the same crossing/checkerboard convention are related by Conway mutations. Only this elementary Section4 implication is imported; no rank, bridge, meridional-rank or priority conclusion.

new_records.title: Mutant knots
new_records.location: Author manuscript16March2014, definitions printedpp3-4 and Theorem3 with full short proof printedp6
new_records.audit: Read the torus-gluing proof: a chosen lift of each Conway halfturn is isotopic to identity on the branched-cover boundary torus. Credit Viro1976 retained. This survey supplies the audited argument, not a claim to have read the full original Russian proof or exhaustive mutation history.
new_records.original_credit: O.Ya.Viro, Nonprojecting isotopies and knots with homeomorphic coverings, Zap.Nauchn.Sem.LOMI66(1976),133-147; English J.SovietMath12(1)(1979),86-96, doi10.1007/BF01098418; primary MathNet metadata checked, original full proof not audited.
new_records.scope: Conway mutation preserves the homeomorphism type of the double branched cover, hence its fundamental group and group rank. No mutation invariance of bridge number or meridional rank is assumed.

assurance: Only Greene Cor4.5 graph-to-mutation and Morton Thm3/Viro cover-homeomorphism imports are used. Exact finite graph inputs are checked separately. Invariant agreement is a screening cue; no new rank or knot equality follows.
